stories.title: Politiebureau en ME bekogeld na stille tocht voor man die omkwam bij arrestatie

en.title: Police station and riot police pelted after silent march for man who died during arrest
en.summary: A silent march was held in Rotterdam-Zuid for a man who died during an arrest on Saturday. After the march, some participants threw objects at a police station and riot police officers.

stories.title: Polen zet zich schrap voor verdere escalatie nu Russische drones de grens opzoeken

en.title: Poland prepares for further escalation as Russian drones approach border
en.summary: Train delays continue following a Russian drone attack on a Ukrainian passenger train near the Polish border. Russian kamikaze drones struck a train locomotive and a tankstation, causing disruptions to cross-border travel.

stories.title: Inzittenden van in Duitsland neergestort vliegtuigje waren drie Nederlanders

en.title: Occupants of aircraft that crashed in Germany were three Dutch nationals
en.summary: Three Dutch nationals died in the crash of a small aircraft near the German border. The plane departed from Hilversum and disappeared from radar near Erkelenz, Germany.

stories.title: Alle drie inzittenden van neergestort vliegtuigje in Duitsland waren Nederlanders

en.title: All three occupants of aircraft that crashed in Germany were Dutch nationals
en.summary: All three people who died in the crash of an aircraft in Germany were Dutch nationals. The aircraft departed from Vliegschool Hilversum and crashed just across the German border.

stories.title: Vijf jaar cel geëist tegen Nederlandse advocaat in groot Belgisch drugsproces

en.title: Five-year prison sentence demanded against Dutch lawyer in major Belgian drug trial
en.summary: Belgian prosecutors have requested a five-year prison sentence for Dutch lawyer Cem Polat, who is accused of leaking confidential information to a suspected drug gang leader in a significant drug case.

stories.title: De politie zag Alfredo (51) ten onrechte aan voor een fietsendief. Hij overleed bij zijn arrestatie

en.title: Police mistakenly identified Alfredo (51) as a bicycle thief. He died during his arrest
en.summary: A 51-year-old Rotterdam man died during a forceful police arrest after being wrongly suspected of stealing a bicycle. Police have confirmed he was innocent of the alleged offense.

stories.title: Stille tocht voor Alfredo Goeloe die overleed na arrestatie; na afloop onrustig

en.title: Silent march for Alfredo Goeloe who died after arrest; tension erupts afterward
en.summary: A silent march took place in Rotterdam to remember 51-year-old Alfredo Goeloe, who died shortly after police detained him during a bicycle theft investigation. His widow, seven months pregnant, expressed her anger over the incident.

stories.title: Drie mogelijke handlangers Bolle Jos opgepakt in Ghana

en.title: Three possible accomplices of Bolle Jos arrested in Ghana
en.summary: Ghana's drug enforcement agency arrested three suspected associates of drug criminal Jos L., known as Bolle Jos, following the seizure of nearly 4,000 kilograms of cocaine by French customs in a container from Ghana.

stories.title: 'Dit is Poetins terreur die direct bij de EU en de NAVO aan de deur klopt'. Europa ziet in Russische aanval op trein bij Oekraïens-Poolse grens bewijs van verdere escalatie

en.title: 'This is Putin's terror knocking directly at the EU and NATO's door'. Europe sees evidence of further escalation in Russian attack on train at Ukrainian-Polish border
en.summary: Russia conducted a drone attack on a Ukrainian train near the Polish border Sunday morning, part of an escalating pattern of Russian attacks since summer. The target was reportedly a diplomatic train carrying European former premiers that had just departed.

stories.title: Drie handlangers van Bolle Jos opgepakt in Ghana

en.title: Three accomplices of Bolle Jos arrested in Ghana
en.summary: Three individuals have been arrested in Ghana on suspicion of representing a criminal and facilitating his illegal operations in the country.

stories.title: Ghana arresteert handlangers 'Bolle Jos' na vondst van bijna 4.000 kilo cocaïne

en.title: Ghana arrests accomplices of 'Bolle Jos' following discovery of nearly 4,000 kilos of cocaine
en.summary: Ghana arrested three suspected associates of a criminal figure following a seizure of 3,900 kilograms of cocaine in France.

stories.title: Drie Nederlanders overleden na crash met Hilversums vliegtuigje net over de Duitse grens

en.title: Three Dutch people died after crash involving Hilversum aircraft just over German border
en.summary: A Cessna 172 aircraft from Hilversum flight school crashed just across the German border, resulting in three Dutch fatalities. The aircraft was completely destroyed upon impact.
